SELECT rfm_snapshots.id, rfm_snapshots.period_from, rfm_snapshots.period_to, rfm_snapshots.calculated_at, rfm_snapshots.client_count, rfm_snapshots.duration_ms, rfm_snapshots.algorithm_version, rfm_snapshots.boundaries, rfm_snapshot_clients.snapshot_id, rfm_snapshot_clients.client_key, rfm_snapshot_clients.client, rfm_snapshot_clients.r_score, rfm_snapshot_clients.f_score, rfm_snapshot_clients.m_score, rfm_snapshot_clients.rfm_code, rfm_snapshot_clients.segment, rfm_snapshot_clients.tags, rfm_snapshot_clients.recency_days, rfm_snapshot_clients.frequency, rfm_snapshot_clients.monetary, rfm_snapshot_clients.average_check, rfm_snapshot_clients.first_purchase, rfm_snapshot_clients.last_purchase, rfm_snapshot_clients.metrics 
FROM rfm_snapshots JOIN rfm_snapshot_state ON rfm_snapshot_state.active_snapshot_id = rfm_snapshots.id LEFT OUTER JOIN rfm_snapshot_clients ON rfm_snapshot_clients.snapshot_id = rfm_snapshots.id AND rfm_snapshot_clients.client_key = lower(trim($1::VARCHAR)) 
WHERE rfm_snapshot_state.id = $2::INTEGER

SELECT sales.id AS sale_id, sale_items.code, sale_items.article, sale_items.name, coalesce(sum(sale_items.quantity), $1::INTEGER) AS quantity 
FROM sales LEFT OUTER JOIN sale_items ON sale_items.sale_id = sales.id 
WHERE lower(trim(sales.client)) = lower(trim($2::VARCHAR)) AND sales.sale_date BETWEEN $3::DATE AND $4::DATE GROUP BY sales.id, sale_items.code, sale_items.article, sale_items.name

SELECT catalog_lookups.identity, catalog_lookups.status, catalog_products.product_id, catalog_products.synced_at, catalog_products.brand, catalog_products.manufacturer, catalog_products.legacy_category, catalog_products.subcategory, catalog_products.material, catalog_products.horeca, catalog_products.category, catalog_products.category_id, catalog_products.image_url 
FROM catalog_lookups LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_products ON catalog_products.product_id = catalog_lookups.product_id 
WHERE catalog_lookups.identity IN ($1::VARCHAR, $2::VARCHAR, $3::VARCHAR, $4::VARCHAR)
